Initial release of Calliope v0.1.0

Ulysses-style hybrid Markdown editor for VS Code.
Features:
- Inline rendering \(headers, emphasis, code, links, task lists\)
- Three-state visibility \(rendered/ghost/raw\)
- Clickable task checkboxes
- Zero document modification
EOF
\)")
